s-1505751017344471101.title: 🎟️ DISCORD VIOLATION REPORTING
s-1505751017344471101.description:
Contact a Moderator if you need help with Discord-related issues or want to report a rule violation.

Please note: This is for Discord-related issues only. It is not for in-game or account support.

Click the button below to create a support ticket.
- Answer a few questions to submit your ticket.
- To report a specific message, right-click it and select Copy Message Link.
- Include screenshots if they can help explain the issue.
- Once your ticket is created, a private channel will open where you can communicate with the Moderator handling your report.
- Please be patient. A Moderator will respond as soon as possible.
